name: Lilan
source: Lilan, a skilled seamstress residing in Blazeer, specialized in crafting uniforms for the temple of Blazeer. When Karder requested her to sew a uniform for him, she declined, setting a peculiar condition: she demanded his help in exacting revenge on her unfaithful husband Gelbart. She wanted Karder to locate Gelbart, bring him home, tie him up, and fuck her in his presence.
